meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞／曲：趙治德、璽恩、楊蒨時
英譯詞：宋怡萌

lines.a: 站立在 祢信實面前
祢雙手領我 走出曠野
lines.b: You lead me out from the wilderness
I see what You've prepared for me

lines.a: 光照在黑暗裡 使臉上帕子都挪去
lines.b: Light shining in the dark, lifting the veil off from my face

lines.a: 祢話語如鏡 煉淨我心
lines.b: Your Word's a mirror, cleansing my heart

lines.a: 榮上加榮 因祢聖靈
lines.b: Glory to glory by Your Spirit

lines.a: 我要貼近 貼近祢心跳的聲音
lines.b: I will draw near, draw near to hear Your heartbeat

lines.a: 思緒如祢 步伐如祢 更靠近祢
lines.b: To think like You, to walk like You, closer to You

lines.a: 活出 像祢 豐盛的生命
lines.b: To live as You, abundant life

lines.a: 我要領受 祢起初對我的心意
lines.b: I will receive, your will towards me from the start

lines.a: 我心渴望 榮耀如祢 聖潔如祢
lines.b: I long to be glorious like you, holy like you

lines.a: 基督 耶穌 我全屬於祢
lines.b: Jesus Christ, I belong to You

lines.a: 我心 坦然無懼 敬拜祢 跟隨祢
lines.b: Boldly, with all of my heart, worship You, follow You

lines.a: 永恆 在祢手裡 我放下 自己
lines.b: You hold eternity, I lay down my life
